laws.rule: Rand Nature Centre, Freeport: pay the applicable park admission and arrange a BNT tour guide in advance if needed. The operator publishes Monday to Friday 09:00 to 13:00 visiting hours. The 2022 bylaws prohibit unauthorised taking or feeding of wildlife and removal of shells, rocks or plant material. Do not disturb other visitors or wildlife with noise.

The 2022 bylaws include park-specific fishing and hunting exceptions; no blanket no-fishing claim is made. Admission and permit fee amounts not checked in this record.
